prompt: This photorealistic photo captures a bustling botanical greenhouse filled with vibrant life and intricate details. On the left, a tall woman in a yellow raincoat stands next to a large fern, holding a silver watering can. Beside her, a small child in blue overalls points at a blooming orchid on a wooden shelf. In the center, an elderly man with a white beard sits on a wrought iron bench, reading a thick book while a tabby cat sleeps on his lap. Next to the bench, a young girl in a pink dress looks at a glass terrarium containing a green gecko. To the right, a gardener in muddy boots kneels beside a patch of soil, planting a red tulip bulb with careful hands. A brown dog lies nearby, watching the gardener with keen interest. Behind them, a couple shares a moment; the man in a grey suit hands a ticket to the woman in a floral dress, who smiles warmly. Above them, hanging baskets of ivy drape down from the metal ceiling beams. A parrot perches on a high branch, observing the scene below with bright eyes. Near the entrance, a security guard in a navy uniform checks a clipboard, standing rigidly by the door. A tourist with a camera around their neck takes a picture of a massive cactus in the corner. Two students in university hoodies discuss a diagram on a placard, leaning in closely. A bee hovers near a sunflower, its wings blurred in motion. A snail crawls slowly along the edge of a stone path. A butterfly rests on a leaf, displaying vivid orange wings. A spider weaves a web between two palm fronds. There is no snow visible anywhere in the warm environment. There is no artificial plastic foliage mixed with the real plants. There is no modern electronic signage disrupting the natural aesthetic. The light filters through the glass roof, illuminating dust motes dancing in the air. The humidity seems palpable as condensation beads on the glass panes. The floor is tiled in a checkered pattern, worn smooth by years of foot traffic. Shelves line the walls, packed with pots of varying sizes and shapes. Tools rest on a nearby table, including trowels and shears. A wheelbarrow sits empty near the back wall. A hose is coiled neatly against a pillar. The atmosphere is one of quiet observation and active care, blending human curiosity with natural growth.
